edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Ordinary plural address and modern third-person verbs restored. Trials and temptation remain distinguished by context (1:2,12–14); 1:13 is rendered cannot be tempted by evil. Complete is retained across 1:4,17,25; act of giving distinguishes the giving from the gift in 1:17. The divine Father-of-lights image, conception and birth, firstfruits, mirror, bridled tongue and unstained religion remain. Become doers in 1:22 restores the imperative’s becoming language. Past narrative forms in 1:11,24 are retained; 1:25 is smoothed without removing doing/hearing contrast.

chapters.decision: Ordinary human address and third-person verbs modernized. The Lord-of-glory expression, partiality, royal law and mercy/judgment are retained. That faith in 2:14 is an interpretive rendering of the article, not a Greek demonstrative. In 2:19 the opening is declarative, matching the displayed NA28 punctuation. Idle in 2:20 follows arge, rather than substituting the variant dead. Justified by works and not by faith alone (2:24) remains without harmonizing James with Paul.

chapters.decision: Modern third-person verbs restored. The pilot intends in 3:4 renders the pilot’s directing impulse naturally. The bridle, rudder, tongue/fire, wheel of life, poison, spring and fruit images remain, as do Lord and Father (3:9), sweet/bitter water, complete man (3:2), and the ordered qualities of wisdom.

chapters.decision: The two opening where questions and the pleasures that wage war are preserved in natural English. Adulteresses is retained without adding a masculine doublet. The difficult spirit/yearning clause (4:5) retains the inherited God-as-subject interpretation provisionally. Ordinary human imperatives remain you. The life-as-vapor image, conditional future life and action, and condemnation of omission remain.

chapters.decision: The fire simile in 5:3 now modifies devouring flesh, matching displayed NA28 punctuation, rather than treasure storage. In 5:6 He does not oppose you replaces the inherited question, matching displayed NA28 declarative punctuation. Modern verbs and ordinary you address restored. Lord Sabaoth, the day of slaughter, early/late rain, doors, Job, the sick person, oil, confession and prayer remain. The prayer participle in 5:16 stays when it is at work without adding emotional fervor; Elijah’s emphatic prayer and three years six months remain.
